name: Hokuto (Hokkaido, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hokuto city emblem in blue, green and yellow: two crescent-like strokes in blue and green crossed by a yellow stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Hokuto, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 February 2006.

features.role: Hokuto city emblem — two crescent-like strokes in blue and green crossed by a yellow stroke
